items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: And in that NBC Band were Doc Severinsen of course, he was the other young turk

ctx.x: All the very classic things. And then, in those days the guy came along, Steve Allen, and we’re still good friends. Steve came along and they had the Sunday Night Show with a big orchestra, and Skitch was the conductor. I mean it just kind of moved around like that. And then recording sessions. And in that NBC Band were Doc Severinsen of course, he was the other young turk, but there were Will Bradley, a very well known trombone player and band leader at one time; Hymie Shertzer from the old Benny Goodman band; a…
When the big band era kind of faded out, a lot of the musicians found a home —
